Container.Name: OnlyView
Container.Overview:
Villa ONLY VIEW (St Barth) — complete rental webapp: public site (EN/FR) with virtual tour, interactive gallery, live availability and instant quotes; guest portal with online contract e-signature and loyalty points; full owner back-office (calendar, reservations with multi-period pricing, contracts, finance, clients CRM, promotions, multi-user accounts).
Everything is self-contained: SQLite database and photo uploads live in /data. First start creates the schema and seeds default rates + the admin account (admin / onlyview2026 — you are forced to change it at first login).
Admin back-office: http://[IP]:[PORT]/admin

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the website and admin back-office.

Config.Name: Appdata (/data)
Config.Description: Persistent storage: SQLite database (onlyview.db) and photo uploads. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (99 = nobody, the Unraid default). The /data volume is chown'd to this at startup.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (100 = users, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: Demo dataset
Config.Description: Set to 1 on FIRST start to seed demo reservations, clients, expenses and loyalty data (only applies to an empty database).

Config.Name: Initial admin password
Config.Description: Password for the seeded 'admin' account on first start (default: onlyview2026). A password change is forced at first login either way.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: SMTP server for outgoing email (booking confirmations, portal links, contracts). Leave empty to store emails in the admin Email log instead of sending.

Config.Name: SMTP from name
Config.Description: From display name on outgoing email.

Config.Name: iCal feed token
Config.Description: Secret protecting the private calendar feed (/api/ical?token=...) that shows client names. Any long random string. The public feed stays anonymized.

Config.Name: Public site URL
Config.Description: Absolute URL used in emails and calendar links (e.g. https://onlyviewstbarth.com, or http://TOWER-IP:3000 for LAN-only use). Note: URLs baked into pre-rendered pages are set at image build time; override the NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL build-arg to change those.
